shortDescription: Apply/Remove ACL configuration on interfaces for AOS-CX.

options.name: acl_direction
options.description: Direction for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: acl_interface_list
options.description: List of interfaces for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: Name of the ACL being applied or removed from the interface.

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of ACL being applied or removed from the interfaces.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete the ACL configuration from the interfaces.
